question: A sphere of radius 30 cm is melted and recast into hemispherical bowls, each of external radius 10 cm and wall thickness 1 cm . How many such bowls can be made? (in approx)
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of sphere = 30 cm

External radius of bowl = 10 cm

Thickness = 1 cm ⇒ Internal radius = 10 − 1 = 9 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of sphere = (4/3) × π × r³

Volume of hemispherical shell = (2/3) × π × (R³ − r³)
